Name: Eevee Farm
Author: silvermoonchan
Description:
Had an idea for this one, ran a search, and to my surprise no one had done it yet! So I present...the Eevee Farm!

You can buy the Eeveelutions at Marnie's as PokeFoxes. They all live in barns and produce:

-Eevee - quartz
-Flareon - fire quartz
-Jolteon - thunder egg
-Vaporeon - ocean stone
-Umbreon - obsidian
-Espeon -  Star Shards
-Leafeon - earth crystal
-Glaceon - frozen tear
-Sylveon -  fairy stone

Enjoy!
